title: Bunny OS runtime audit record
description: One thing the plan applicator did, with its evidence and its reasoning in separate fields. Mixing them produces a log in which 'the service was stopped because memory was low' cannot be checked, because nobody can tell which half was read off a meter and which half was inference. There is deliberately no field for a credential, a prompt or a task payload, so there is no path by which one is logged; free text is redacted on the way in rather than on the way out, because a redactor at the read end protects nothing once the bytes are on disk.

event.description: A stable identifier. Consumers match on this, never on a message.

atMonotonic.description: The applicator's clock, matching every other time in the runtime. Not wall clock, which steps when NTP corrects it.

observed.description: What was measured or returned. Facts.

inferred.description: What the applicator concluded. Reasoning, and labelled as such so a reader can tell it apart from the evidence.
